original_reference.description: A table scorched with the radial patterns of hot chemistry holds a phial rack and alembic.

source_shape: Wide two-row wooden tabletop at native y14..15, two visible supports/feet below it, phial rack on the left and tall pale-cyan alembic glass loops/tubing above and to the right. Preserve the upright source-map silhouette rather than replacing it with a flat modern counter.

palette.rule: Wood/table/rack/scorch shading is primary; phials/alembic glass is detail. Cyan in the constructed/refined image is an ownership aid; both selected layers become grayscale.

donor_reference.role: Cardinal work-surface and glass readability only; donor layout, metal counter, size and drug/crafting mechanics are not imported.

construction: One shared authored assembly: rectangular scorched wooden surface, two cross-depth trestles, left three-phial rack and tall glass alembic. Hidden trestle/rack joinery, apparatus depth and reverse glass surfaces are authored interpretation; not new native components.
states: Only the declared fixed Alchemist Table tile; inherited empty/full tile/detail tags deleted. Same described rack/alembic in every facing, no invented inventory appearance state.
inventory_boundary: Inherited Container/Inventory and population remain native. The rack/alembic in the source bitmap are decorative fixture art; this does not convert or bake independently carried inventory items into the table.

frame.rule: All views and both color roles share same full source-cell mapping, scale and pivot. No independent bounds fitting. South is proposed replacement for existing fixed tile; E/N/W are unbound authoring assets.

native_behavior: Preserve non-occluding Render, inherited organic/wood furniture, container/cover and actual inventory actions. Rare animated/custom states retain native fallback; no crafting/research/drug mechanic is transplanted.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation and integrated source-tile/physical-frame/visibility/container state acceptance.
